title: feat(nstriinc): three-site x-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Same-tick union own lock on the three-site seed {0,(0,1,0),(1,0,0)} with locks +e1,-e1,+e2, x-probe frame. Face HOLD fires through the own-letter channel at C (L(C)=+e1 against -e1 in S^+(D)); reverse fails against the singleton S^+(B)={+e3}. I reproduced both verdicts independently.
